articles.title: Letters: Keystone Street Parking Is Out of Control
body: To the editor: Please keep the community garden in the budget. Many of us on Keystone Street use it every week. I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the May meeting.

Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed. To the editor: I have lived on Keystone Street for 28 years, and I want to say what a difference the Millrace Library branch has made.
Please keep the community garden in the budget. Many of us on Keystone Street use it every week. I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the May meeting.
Roman Kessler, Foundry Row
